CONVERSATION.NAME: Convince Sara You Deserve Her Secret
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Sara says she knows something about Matthew that you don't. She thinks your quest to find out about Matthew's sexuality is ridiculous. Prove to her that you deserve her secret about Matthew.
LIKE: Convince Sara to like you and that you are trustworthy.
BELIEVE: Make Sara believe you.

CARD.NAME: Accessories make the outfit
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Those glasses totally go with your lip ring. And those boots! They're your dad's? I'm loving it.

CARD.NAME: Apologetic.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You are really sorry, making all your likeable dialog stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of like,

CARD.NAME: Compliment
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I bet you didn't know Matthew says you are the smartest coolest lady in town.

CARD.NAME: I know Matthew's fav drink
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Let's see... well, I know Matthew drinks a lot of Chai tea. That's something.

CARD.NAME: Matthew and Dylan hang out
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I know that Matthew and Dylan are friends.

CARD.NAME: Matthew brought Dylan on our date
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I got to Great Wall, and Dylan was there! Wouldn't you be a little curious if that happened to you? Dylan even made a pass at me!

CARD.NAME: Matthew is an artist
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I know he's an artist, Justin told me art is pretty much his life.

CARD.NAME: Matthew is sensistive
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa says he really listens to her, not like the other guys around here.

CARD.NAME: Matthew was made for me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew and I are a perfect match! We compliment each other in so many ways. I'm yin to his yang, like the tattoo on his ankle.

CARD.NAME: Matthew's Morning Coffee
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I know that Matthew comes by here in the morning to get his coffee.

CARD.NAME: Poor me, lucky you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew's so cool and mysterious and I am so completely scared of getting hurt. I guess someone as together as you wouldn't know what that's like...

CARD.NAME: Rumor: I had a reason to wonder
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I mean, Matthew has never had a girlfriend, right? It made me wonder.

CARD.NAME: Thanks for setting me straight
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You really know how to break out the Oprah. I can see now why everyone comes to you with their problems.

CARD.NAME: You're right Sara.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I guess we all have stupid silly insecurities, thanks for having the maturity to help me with mine.

CARD.NAME: You're so secure in your womynhood
CARD.DESCRIPTION: It's cool how comfortable you are with your sexuality, it's super inspirational.

CARD.NAME: Distrust
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara just doesn't seem to trust you, all her -like statements are strengthened.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of like,

CARD.NAME: I'm a pretty big deal.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Yeah, I know a lot about the people in this burg, more than most. It's because they know, I know, they know that I'm trustworthy.

CARD.NAME: Matthew is sensistive
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew IS sensisitive, and he likes people that think about other people's feelings. Know what I mean?

CARD.NAME: Me and Matthew go waaaaay back.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I've known Matthew since we were kids. I only had one piercing when we met!

CARD.NAME: Not Mattie's Type
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew is a cool discerning guy and one of my oldest friends, you DO NOT seem to be his type.

CARD.NAME: Something strange...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I dunno...there's something kind of sketchy about you, mostly in the eyes, mouth, nose, face region.

CARD.NAME: Style points.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The face is nice and the bod's rockin', but all the gossip is more than just a little unconvincing.

CARD.NAME: Words can hurt.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you knew how much it hurts to be different you'd think twice before you talked trash about people you don't know anything about.

CARD.NAME: You seem to know the obvious
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sure, you might know where he hangs out or what he likes to drink. But that's not really knowing someone, is it?

CARD.NAME: You're so not convincing.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I am totally underwhelmed by your knowledge of the subject. Are we even talking about the same Matthew?
